article_title: The 5P Reflection Model for Education in the Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Era
citation: Rajan Kadel, Samar Shailendra, Islam Mohammad Tahidul, Urvashi Rahul Saxena, Aakanksha Sharma, and Sabitra Kaphle. (2026). The 5P Reflection Model for Education in the Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Era. Pre-print submitted to IEEE Transactions on Education. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03413
title: 5P reflection model: an iterative five-stage GenAI-aware reflection model
description: The 5P Reflection Model is an iterative reflective model with five stages: Purpose, Process, Product, Pitfalls and Plan, with emotional factors considered across all stages. It synthesises features from experiential, transformative, reflective-practitioner, affective and self-regulated learning theories and incorporates the technological dimensions of GenAI. The article states it is proposed "to manage greater demand for reflection, ii) to address the limitations of the existing reflection models, iii) to consider technological aspects of GenAI."
requirements: Learners document prompts, iterations and output evaluations during the Process stage, and validate GenAI output against reliable sources in the Product stage
constraints: The article presents the model as a design-based research proposal without empirical validation of learning outcomes in the text provided
target_learners: higher education students using GenAI tools
examples: Each stage is operationalised: Purpose sets goals and intended GenAI use; Process documents prompting and iteration; Product validates output and distinguishes human from GenAI contribution; Pitfalls reflects on factual, ethical and privacy risks; Plan sets refined future goals
